Editing: calls and computation dependencies
|
|-- [C] UI or agent bridge invokes controller.applyUpdate(...)
|   `-- Inputs: expectedVersion, operations
|
|-- 1. Validate and stage
|   |-- [D] expected version + current version -> conflict check
|   `-- [D] document + interaction state -> staged state
|
|-- 2. Apply operations
|   |-- Content changes
|   |   `-- [C] DiagramService.create / revise
|   |       `-- [D] new revision + node correspondence
|   `-- Instance and view changes
|       `-- Update boxes / edges / sections / views
|
|-- 3. Derive consistent layout and presentation
|   |-- Grid layout and validation
|   |   |-- [D] ASCII dimensions + box hierarchy -> final cell bounds
|   |   `-- Anchor changed box; push colliding siblings
|   |-- Connection reconciliation
|   |   `-- [D] content changes + correspondence
|   |       `-- Retained, reanchored or stale endpoints
|   `-- Floating geometry
|       |-- [D] grid bounds + placement policies
|       |   `-- Pixel positions and dimensions
|       `-- Floating bounds never displace GridBoxes
|
|-- 4. Commit and publish
|   |-- [C] CanvasHistoryService.append
|   |   `-- [D] document + view + correspondence
|   |       `-- Checkpoint and advanced version
|   `-- [C] Notify subscribers with updated snapshot
|       `-- Session -> workspace persistence
|
`-- Other exposed editing operations
    |-- [C] commitDocument(...): document and layout edits
    `-- [C] updateCanvas(...) / select(...)
        |-- Pane, control and selection state
        `-- Ordinary controls and measurements add no checkpoint
